name: Blue Tokai
steps:
How to redeem the card for a dine-in / pick-up order at a café?

  • Download the Blue Tokai app here.
  • Register using your phone number.
  • Tap the Wallet icon at the bottom of the screen and select "Redeem a Gift Card."
  • Enter your Gift Card Number and PIN—the amount will be added to your wallet.
  • Visit a Blue Tokai café, and place your order through the app by clicking on the “Cafés” icon in the menu.
  • At checkout, select "BTC Wallet" to pay using your gift card balance.


How to redeem the card to place a delivery order from the roastery?

On the App:

  • Download the Blue Tokai app here and register using your phone number.
  • Tap the Wallet icon at the bottom of the screen and select "Redeem a Gift Card."
  • Enter your Gift Card Number and PIN—the amount will be added to your wallet.
  • Click on the “Shop” icon in the menu, and add the desired products to your cart.
  • At checkout, select "BTC Wallet" to pay using your gift card balance and complete your order.

On the Website:

  • Visit our official Blue Tokai website here and add the products you’d like to your cart.
  • In the cart, scroll to the bottom and check the box that says “Pay via Gift Cards”, then click the “Check Out” button (do not use the “Buy Now” button).
  • On the checkout page, enter your Gift Card Number and PIN, then click “Add Gift Card.”
  • You can add more gift cards if needed. Once done, click “Validate Gift Cards” to view the total available balance.
  • Enter the amount you'd like to redeem (equal to or less than the balance), and click “Redeem Cards.” This will reduce your order total accordingly.
  • Follow the remaining on-screen steps to complete your purchase.
